title: preventDefault on submit

blocks.md:
## Submit does not have to leave

A form’s default submit reloads or leaves the page. `event.preventDefault()` stops that default. The listener still runs. You keep the typed words on this desk.

Listen for `submit` on `#desk`. Prevent the default. Copy `#q` into `#out` with `textContent`. The fox files a query without the board going blank.
